basic_info.description: Unlock the potential of this 2-story, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom gem in one of the city's most convenient locations! Whether you're a motivated buyer or a savvy investor, this property offers the perfect canvas to create something truly exceptional. Enjoy seamless access to public transportation and major freeways, making it a commuter's dream while maintaining the charm of a vibrant neighborhood.    The drought-resistant backyard is a standout feature, complete with a shed and bonus space ready to serve as a workshop, creative studio, or additional storage. But the real value lies in the untapped potentialan additional bonus area perfect for an ADU, unlocking significant income opportunities or expand living options for multi-generational needs.    Whether you envision transforming this home into a modern masterpiece or building equity through smart investment, this is your chance to capitalize on a rare opportunity. Schedule a tour today and let your vision take shape!
